packages.title: The Grand Exploration Mahayatra
packages.description: The most comprehensive package covering "Mini-Kashmir" and the historic Fort.

itinerary.title: Arrival & Venna Lake
activities: Pickup from Pune. Check-in and relax.
Evening stroll at the Mahabaleshwar Market and Venna Lake.

itinerary.title: History & Sunset
activities: Morning trip to the mighty Pratapgad Fort (History of Shivaji Maharaj).
Afternoon visit to Lodwick Point and Elephant’s Head Point.
Watch a stunning sunset from Bombay Point.

itinerary.title: The "Mini Kashmir" (Tapola)
activities: Full-day excursion to Tapola (Koyna Backwaters).
Enjoy water sports, kayaking, and a peaceful boat ride.
Return to Mahabaleshwar by evening.

itinerary.title: Panchgani Discovery & Return
activities: Morning visit to Old Mahabaleshwar Temples.
Drive to Panchgani: Visit Table Land, Sydney Point, and Devrai Art Village.
Evening drop-off back to Pune.

itinerary.title: The Mighty Pratapgad
activities: Morning drive to the historic Pratapgad Fort (Explore the heritage of Shivaji Maharaj).
Evening visit to Bombay Point (Sunset Point).

itinerary.title: Hidden Gems & Valleys
activities: Visit Lodwick Point, Elephant’s Head Point, and Lingmala Waterfall (Seasonal).
Afternoon drive to Panchgani for Sydney Point and Dhom Dam views.

itinerary.title: Leisure & Shopping
activities: Morning at Venna Lake.
Afternoon shopping at the Mahabaleshwar Main Market (Leather goods, Honey, Jams).

packages.title: The "Leisure & Luxury" Retreat
packages.best_for: Couples and senior citizens wanting a comfortable, slow-paced holiday.

itinerary.title: Arrival & Venna Lake
activities: Leisurely drive from Mumbai. Afternoon arrival.
Enjoy a private boat ride at Venna Lake.

itinerary.title: Spiritual & Scenic Morning
activities: Visit Panchganga Mandir and Mahabaleshwar Temple.
Afternoon visit to Kate’s Point and Needle Hole.

itinerary.title: Pratapgad & Local Flavors
activities: Morning visit to Pratapgad Fort.
Afternoon visit to a Strawberry Farm (seasonal) and Mapro Garden.

itinerary.title: Panchgani Shopping & Return
activities: Explore Panchgani Market for local handicrafts and honey.
Visit Harrison’s Folly before the downhill drive to Mumbai.

packages.title: The "Classic Hill Getaway"
packages.best_for: Families looking for a quick escape from Mumbai’s humidity.

itinerary.title: The Scenic Climb
activities: Early morning pickup from Mumbai. Drive via Mumbai-Pune Expressway.
Afternoon check-in at Mahabaleshwar.
Evening visit to Venna Lake for boating and Town Market shopping.

itinerary.title: Viewpoints & Strawberry Dreams
activities: Morning visit to Arthur’s Seat, Echo Point, and Tiger Spring.
Afternoon exploration of Old Mahabaleshwar Temples.
Evening visit to Mapro Garden for famous Strawberry Cream and snacks.

itinerary.title: Panchgani Discovery & Return
activities: Check-out and head to Panchgani. Explore Table Land and Parsi Point.
Afternoon visit to Harrison’s Folly for a final view of the valley.
Return journey to Mumbai.
